title: Excavation Daily Inspection
name: Excavation Daily Inspection
description: Recorded excavation inspection covering ground condition, support, water, access, edge protection, services and plant interfaces before work or entry continues.

sections.title: GROUND / SUPPORT / STABILITY
items: Excavation faces show no signs of collapse, cracking or significant deterioration
Shoring, trench boxes, props or battering remain suitable and correctly positioned
Spoil, materials and surcharge loads remain controlled away from the edge
Nearby structures, roads or plant are not adversely affecting stability
Changes in ground or weather conditions have been considered

sections.title: ACCESS / EDGE / SERVICES
items: Safe access and egress are provided and unobstructed
Edge protection / barriers are suitable for the location
Underground or exposed services remain identified and protected

sections.title: WATER / PLANT / WORK INTERFACES
items: Water ingress / pumping arrangements are controlled
Plant cannot endanger people working in or near the excavation
Atmospheric hazards have been considered where relevant
Linked lifting, temporary works or other activities do not create uncontrolled risk

fields.label: Inspection Result
options: PASS - excavation may remain in use
RESTRICTIONS - use only with stated controls
